problems.name: malformed tool-call JSON escapes and raw control characters

attempts.what: Repair raw unescaped control chars and invalid backslash escapes (Windows paths, regex classes) inside JSON string literals via parseJsonWithRepair before failing tool-call decoding.

problems.name: edit patch format contamination across apply_patch and hashline dialects

attempts.what: Strip lenient shell heredoc wrappers in apply_patch parser and reject apply_patch sentinels or unified-diff @@ headers inside hashline with explicit corrective errors.

problems.name: silent empty completions and unpaced retry-after backoffs on flaky gateways

attempts.what: Retry degenerate zero-output-token stop completions without retrying billed thinking turns, and derive max safe backoff from retry-after / x-ratelimit-reset-ms headers without duplicating retry-after-ms hints.

problems.name: oversized tool output and approval payloads corrupting UTF-8 bounds or hiding trailing errors

attempts.what: Enforce UTF-8 byte caps with firstLineExceedsLimit in truncateHead, preserve trailing failure lines in truncateTail, and cap oversized approval prompt arguments via truncateForPrompt.

problems.name: approval bypasses, unscoped rule triggers, and prompt-cache prefix churn on harness updates

attempts.what: Keep explicit user deny authoritative even in yolo mode, scope TTSR rule triggers to matching globs, and inject full SIM context after project context while keeping block 0 byte-stable and Fusion policies terminal.

problems.name: cross-model reasoning effort, thinking replay, and stream markup incompatibilities in pi-catalog

attempts.what: Map Ollama unsupported minimal/xhigh efforts to low/max without clobbering overrides, gate OpenCode reasoning_content replay inside whenThinking only, and route stream markup healing per model family (thinking/kimi/dsml/harmony).
